name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
why_special: 414 rooms on Senapati Bapat Road equidistant from Koregaon Park and Hinjawadi — 8 dining venues including Spice Kitchen (Indian) and Alto Vino (Italian). The Pune business 5-star with rooftop temperature-controlled pool and easiest cross-city positioning.

name: Conrad Pune
why_special: Hilton's Conrad on Mangaldas Road — closer to Aga Khan Palace / Shaniwar Wada heritage core than the IT-park hotels. Rooftop pool, Coriander Kitchen all-day buffet praised for breakfast spread variety. The default pick when your Pune trip mixes old-city sightseeing with business.

name: Hyatt Regency Pune
why_special: Large-format Hyatt on Weikfield IT Park 25 min from Pune airport (PNQ) — the airport-run hotel with strong conference facilities and reliable Hyatt service at roughly 25% less than JW Marriott. Best last-night-before-flight bed in Pune.

name: Marriott Suites Pune
why_special: All-suite Marriott in Koregaon Park — Pune's best neighbourhood for cafes, boutiques, and nightlife. Suites are notably larger than standard 5-star rooms, pet-friendly, 10-min walk to German Bakery and Osho Garden. The Pune pick for longer stays or families.

name: The O Hotel Pune
why_special: Boutique design hotel on North Main Road, Koregaon Park — rooftop pool with city view, Addis Ababa for African cuisine. The walk-out neighbourhood for cafes and nightlife minus the 5-star pricing.

name: Hotel Sunderban
why_special: 1932 Art Deco bungalow in Koregaon Park — 32 rooms across the original house and newer block, vegetarian Maharashtrian/Gujarati thali at Mango Tree restaurant, gardens used for Pune weddings. The closest thing to a heritage stay in Koregaon Park.
